sourceFile: Antimatter Dimensions - Eternity and Eternity Challenges (1).xlsx

objectives.title: Buy your first Time Dimension
objectives.description: With your first EP point buy Time Dimension 1 (TD1), go to the Infinity Upgrades page and enable the auto x2 IP multiplier. Progress through everything again, remember to Break Infinity, complete all normal challenges and ICs.

objectives.title: Reach e426 IP and earn 3 EP
objectives.description: The final goal is to get e426IP which gives 3EP on Eternity. Buying all TT along the way will get 9TT, these should be spent into TS : 11,21,22,33.

objectives.title: Enable Respec Time Studies
objectives.description: Before you Eternity press "Respec Time Studies on next Eternity" to enable it, this will refund all your spent TT back so you can select different TS.

objectives.title: Get 11 TT and unlock TS42
objectives.description: Purchases so far : e80,000AM , e400IP . With 3EP spend this on 2 TT purchases for 1EP and 2EP. Giving a total of 11TT to use in the TS tree. TS setup : 11,22,32,42 .

objectives.title: Get TS51
objectives.description: The next goal is to push and pick up TT from purchases of e100,000AM and e500IP. After e500IP you can Eternity for 4EP. Purchase the 4EP TT, you now have 3TT to spend on the TS tree, put this into TS51 for a nice boost to IP.

objectives.title: Get TS61
objectives.description: Now do an even longer push to pick up TT purchases e120,000AM and e600IP, RGs are the primary means of pushing. Continue the run to e614IP so you can Eternity for 8EP. Purchase the 8EP TT, and add TS61.

objectives.title: Get e120,000 AM, e600 IP, 8 EP TT
objectives.description: Purchases so far : e120,000AM , e600IP , 8EP TT = 17TT. TS setup : 11,22,32,42,51,61 .

objectives.title: Reach Eternity Milestone 5
objectives.description: Remember to check all upgrade pages and the Infinity Dimensions page and buy everything available in each Eternity. Milestone 5 unlocks more Autocrunch options, I recommend X times highest at 1e10.

objectives.title: Reach EM7 and buy EU1 + EU2
objectives.description: Before Milestone 7 I do all IC except IC5, with TS42 you don't need to stress about that challenge anymore. Following EM7 you can up the crunch buyer to 1e20. Spend EP on Eternity Upgrades 1 + 2.

objectives.title: Reach EM9 and tune your autobuyers
objectives.description: Milestone 9 is a big boost to speed, check to make sure the Galaxy autobuyer is set to 0s. As for Max Dimboost, set this to 0.4s so it does not interfere with the Galaxy autobuyer. Under 30s Eternity (R104) is possible now.

objectives.title: Buy the 500 EP ×5 EP upgrade
objectives.description: You can pick up extra TDs that cost less than 100EP as they help progress through each Eternity faster. Save up for and buy the 500EP x5EP upgrade to really get the EP income.

objectives.title: Reach Eternity Milestone 25
objectives.description: Milestone 25 finally removes the issue of having to manually unlock and buy Infinity Dimensions making each Eternity much smoother. Make sure to enable the Replicanti autobuyers when they are unlocked.

objectives.title: Get TS71 and reach 100 Eternities
objectives.description: Spend EP into TDs and TT for anything costing 500EP or less. This will be 5 more purchases into the EP for TT, though you only need 4 more for TS71. Keep pushing to EM100 to get the Eternity autobuyer.

objectives.title: Get e120,000 AM, e600 IP, 256 EP TT
objectives.description: Purchases so far : e120,000AM , e600IP , 256EP TT = 22TT. TS setup : 11,22,32,42,51,61,71

objectives.title: Buy the next ×5 EP upgrade and EU3
objectives.description: At 100 eternities set up the new Eternity Autobuyer to 300EP. Let the autobuyers farm up to 2.5e4EP for the next x5 EP upgrade. After that let the autobuyer farm up to 5e4EP for Eternity Upgrade 3.

objectives.title: Get the “Never Again” achievement
objectives.description: With EU3, disable Eternity autobuyer. Let the auto crunches get you to e600IP, rerun all ICs (retry challenges on) and get "Never Again" achievement which should give a 6.38e14 multiplier on EU3.

objectives.title: Get e200,000 AM and e900 IP
objectives.description: Now focus on pushing AM + IP to get TT.You should be able to push to e200,000AM and e900IP quickly, remember to start getting to max RG then crunching. When you eternity spend EP on TDs.

objectives.title: Get TS81, TS91, and TS101
objectives.description: The TS setup you want is : 11,22,32,42,51,61,71,81,91,101 ->21->33. You can always buy TS21 while pushing if you only have 3TT spare. Respec if you get 1 more TT to afford TS91 / TS101 instead of TS21.

objectives.title: Farm to 40 TT
objectives.description: Do several runs with focus on EP/min, buying TDs 3.3e4EP and below. Now do a long run and purchase e220,000AM and e1,100IP. Back to farming EP/min again to be put into EP TT to 6.55e4EP so you have 40TT.

objectives.title: Get a 3–4 second Eternity
objectives.description: Change the Eternity autobuyer to 0 and enable it. Test crunchs 1e25 / e35 / e45 / e55 / e65 to get your fastest Eternity to a low 4s or even 3s (Try pressing M to get faster results). This will help boost TS92 for the next tree.

objectives.title: Switch to the Infinity Dimension path
objectives.description: Purchases so far : e220,000AM , e1,100IP , 6.55e4EP TT = 40TT. Respec to the new TS setup : 11,22,32,42,51,61,72,82,92,102

objectives.title: Improve your fastest Eternity
objectives.description: Continue running 0 on Eternity autobuyer and testing crunch values to lower your fastest eternity time possibly to mid 3s. Once you have that disable the Eternity autobuyer and lets see what EP/min is available.

objectives.title: Get e260,000 AM and e1,200 IP
objectives.description: 1e35 / 1e40 autocrunch works well now. Farm EP/min and buy all TDs below 1e5EP. Buy TT up to 2.62e5EP. Now to push AM + IP. Buy e240,000AM -> e1,200IP -> e260,000AM (Long Push!).

objectives.title: Get TS111 and the 1.25e6 EP upgrade
objectives.description: Repec and swap tree to : 11,22,32,42,51,61,71,81,91,101,111 . Now back to EP/min farming, TS111 will get us more IP but not more AM. Farm to 1.25e6EP and buy the x5 EP upgrade. Keep farming EP/min.

objectives.title: Get e280,000 AM and e1,400 IP
objectives.description: Buy all TD below 2e6EP and buy TT to 1.05e6EP. Now to do a long push and buy e280,000AM and e1,400IP getting TS21 and TS33. Do some more EP/min farming to get 4.19e6EP TT.

objectives.title: Get 52 TT and switch to the ID path
objectives.description: Purchases so far : e280,000AM , e1,400IP , 4.19e6EP TT = 52TT. Respec to the new TS setup : 11,22,32,42,51,61,72,82,92,102,111

objectives.title: Get e300,000 AM and e1,500 IP
objectives.description: Try for another quick eternity time to buff TS92 even more to get the bonus to e6 or more. Now to go for a long push and pick up e300,000AM and e1,500IP.

objectives.title: Get TS122 at 54 TT
objectives.description: Purchases so far : e300,000AM , e1,500IP , 4.19e6EP TT = 54TT. Respec to the new TS setup : 11,22,32,42,51,61,71,81,91,101,111,122

objectives.title: Buy the 6.25e7 EP ×5 EP upgrade
objectives.description: Set up another EP/min farm and get the next x5 EP upgrade at 6.25e7EP. Continue to farm EP/min spending EP into TT up to 1.34e8EP to get TS21 + TS33 and adjust EP/min farming. Buy TD upto 2e8EP.

objectives.title: Get e320,000 AM and e1,600 IP
objectives.description: Continue EP/min farm and get 2.68e8EP TT (or push for 1 more). Now swap TS21 + TS33 over to TS132 (Or use TS121 + TS131 which works much better) and do a long run to get e320,000AM + e1,600IP.

objectives.title: Buy the 5.37e8 EP Time Theorem
objectives.description: If you did not get 5.37e8EP TT then use EP/min farming and get that now. This will allow you to set up the Active Tree (Passive can still work doing EP/min but Active will be better).

objectives.title: Get the Active tree at 63 TT
objectives.description: Purchases so far : e320,000AM , e1,600IP , 5.37e8EP TT = 63TT. Respec to the new TS setup : 11,22,32,42,51,61,71,81,91,101,111,121,131,141

objectives.title: Set up TS121 for a 50× bonus
objectives.description: Make sure to set up TS121 to 50x for each Active run that you do from now. At first EP/min in a long run will not be as good, but having to do the TS121 setup for short runs is not worth it, run to around e1,600IP.

objectives.title: Get e340,000 AM and e1,800 IP
objectives.description: Purchase TD costing less than 1e9EP and buy the TT for 1.07e9EP. Now do a longer run to get e1,700IP and e340,000AM to add in TS21 and continue to e1,800IP.

objectives.title: Switch to the ID path at 67 TT
objectives.description: Purchases so far : e340,000AM , e1,800IP , 1.07e9EP TT = 67TT. Make sure TS92 is Capped at 1.07e9x. Respec to the new TS setup : 11,22,32,42,51,61,72,82,92,102,111,121,131

objectives.title: Get TS141 and the 3.13e9 EP upgrade
objectives.description: ID path will let you go further, push to buy e360,000AM and e1,900IP then add in TS21 and get to e380,000AM. Respec to remove TS21 and add in TS141. The next EP purchase is the x5 EP at 3.13e9EP.

objectives.title: Buy TT through 1.72e10 EP
objectives.description: Continue Active runs, get all TD below 1.06e10EP then focus on TT purchases up to 1.72e10EP. You should be able to pick up TS21 and e2,000IP while going for the TT and then TS33.

objectives.title: Get e400,000 AM and e2,100 IP
objectives.description: Get TD2 costing 1.74e10EP, now push a run to get e400,000AM and e2,100IP. You should have enough EP to get the 3.44e10EP TT.

objectives.title: Get e440,000 AM and e2,300 IP
objectives.description: Do a long run picking up e420,000AM -> e2,200IP -> e440,000AM to get TS21 again which can push you to e2,300IP. Now focus getting EP for the 1.56e11EP x5 EP upgrade.

objectives.title: Get TS161
objectives.description: With that bought put EP into the 6.87e10EP TT to get TS33 to help farm EP faster. Buy TD below 2e11EP. Push to e460,000AM and e2,400IP respec and change TS21 + TS33 into TS161.

objectives.title: Get e480,000 AM and e2,500 IP
objectives.description: Buy up to 5.50e11EP TT to get TS21 again. Buy TD1 for 2.82e11EP. Do a long run for e480,000AM and e2,500IP to get TS33 back. Now farm EP and buy the 7.81e12EP x5 EP upgrade.

objectives.title: Buy TT through 4.40e12 EP
objectives.description: The reason we go for the x5 is that other purchases would not help as much. Do more runs to buy all TD below 4e12EP and then focus on buying TT to 4.40e12EP.

objectives.title: Get e520,000 AM and e2,700 IP
objectives.description: Now to do a long run and pick up e500,000AM and e2,600IP to get TS21 back, continue the run to pick up e520,000AM and e2,700IP to get TS33. Buy TD1 at 7.63e12EP and now farm EP to buy TT to 3.52e13EP.

objectives.title: Get e560,000 AM and e2,900 IP
objectives.description: Push far to pick up e540,000AM -> e2,800IP -> e560,000AM and get TS21 to help push for e2,900IP. Now focus on buying the 7.04e13EP TT so you can get TS33. Go for all TD below 1e14EP.

objectives.title: Buy the 3.9e14 EP ×5 EP upgrade
objectives.description: Continue EP farming for the 5x EP at 3.9e14EP, buy all TD below 5e14EP and then buy TT up to 2.81e14EP, pick up e580,000AM on your last run.

objectives.title: Get e600,000 AM and e3,100 IP
Buy the achievement-based Eternity Upgrade
objectives.description: Spend EP into 5.63e14EP TT to get TS33 back for smoother farming. Spend EP in TD below 1e15EP, you will need to do several runs to farm up 1e16EP for the Eternity Upgrade based on achievements.

objectives.title: Get e640,000 AM and e3,300 IP
objectives.description: Try to clean up as many achievements as possible to buff the Eternity Upgrade. Now do a long run to get to e640,000AM and e3,300IP, then purchase the 1.13e15EP TT after the run.

objectives.title: Get TS31 and set up Eternity farming
objectives.description: You now have the perfect TT to farm Eternities. Use TS Tree : 11,21,22,31,32,41,42,51,61,72,82,92,102,111,121,131,141,151,161,162,171  . Eternity autobuyer = 0 , Dimboost autobuyer = Disabled , Crunch = 1e112

objectives.title: Farm at least 20,000 Eternities
objectives.description: The crunch buyer is what I found works best for me, you can adjust it to try find a better average Eternity time. Get to 20,000 Eternities minimum, it is recommended to get 110,000 for Eternity Upgrade 2.

objectives.title: Buy the 1.95e16 EP ×5 EP upgrade
objectives.description: After farming eternities Respec your TS Tree : 11,21,22,31,32,33,42,51,61,73,83,93,103,111,121,131,141,151,161,162,171  . Check autobuyers! Buy all TD below 2e15EP. Now farm to the 1.95e16EP x5 EP upgrade.

objectives.title: Get e700,000 AM and e3,600 IP
objectives.description: Buy all TD below 6e16EP then focus on building up 3e17EP to be used later, add in TS41 when possible. With the extra EP do a longer run to pick up e700,000AM and e3,600IP. Buy TT to get 1.44e17EP TT.
